name: Intertwined
storyline:
Within the world, life marches on in its never-ending cycle. Those caught within its unbridled grasp know naught of anything else other than the cruel grasp of fate. Yet, there exists those who are born to defy the laws that govern the realms. For they are known as Transcendents. Beings of untold chaos stirs within the center of all existence, a maelstrom of untapped, incomprehensible power only spoken of within ancient stories of eld. Yet, to some, those stories are more than fantasy. In the darkest corners of your mind, it stirs. Watching. Waiting. Preparing. For the moment you let yourself slip. For in the darkness, void of the safety of light, it stalks its prey. Awaiting for the right time to pounce.

All may seem normal, but in truth we shed ignorance and in shedding ignorance, we become enlightened to the true nature of what lies beyond the grasp of our fingertips.

What may exist you ask?

Only time will tell. Only fate can answer. As our lives become Intertwined!
summary: Intertwined is an adult rated supernatural adventure story that is told through branching paths based on a devotion system. There is no choosing a pathway to follow, the number of devotion points determines what scenes you will uncover and which you may miss. Devotion will be obtained through various choices and actions made within the Visual Novel.
